ADD VERTEX Album (PRIMARY_ID id STRING, name STRING, doc_id STRING, doc_title STRING, type_text STRING, released STRING, released_year INT, released_iso STRING, artist STRING, label STRING, genre STRING, producer STRING, length STRING, next_title STRING, recorded STRING, prev_title STRING, next_year STRING, next_year_num DOUBLE, prev_year STRING, prev_year_num DOUBLE) WITH PRIMARY_ID_AS_ATTRIBUTE="true"

ADD VERTEX Officeholder (PRIMARY_ID id STRING, name STRING, doc_id STRING, doc_title STRING, term_start STRING, term_start_year INT, term_start_iso STRING, term_end STRING, term_end_year INT, term_end_iso STRING, predecessor STRING, successor STRING, office STRING, birth_date STRING, birth_date_year INT, birth_date_iso STRING, birth_place STRING, order_text STRING, order_num DOUBLE, spouse STRING, party STRING, children STRING, children_num DOUBLE, birth_name STRING, education STRING, lieutenant STRING, death_date STRING, death_date_num DOUBLE, death_place STRING, district STRING, district_num DOUBLE, branch STRING, president STRING, service_years STRING, service_years_num DOUBLE, prime_minister STRING) WITH PRIMARY_ID_AS_ATTRIBUTE="true"

ADD VERTEX Person (PRIMARY_ID id STRING, name STRING, doc_id STRING, doc_title STRING, occupation STRING, birth_date STRING, birth_date_year INT, birth_date_iso STRING, birth_place STRING, years_active STRING, years_active_num DOUBLE, spouse STRING, birth_name STRING, children STRING, children_num DOUBLE, awards STRING, education STRING) WITH PRIMARY_ID_AS_ATTRIBUTE="true"

ADD VERTEX SkiArea (PRIMARY_ID id STRING, name STRING, doc_id STRING, doc_title STRING, location STRING, vertical STRING, vertical_num DOUBLE, top_elevation STRING, top_elevation_num DOUBLE, base_elevation STRING, base_elevation_num DOUBLE) WITH PRIMARY_ID_AS_ATTRIBUTE="true"

ADD VERTEX TennisTournamentEvent (PRIMARY_ID id STRING, name STRING, doc_id STRING, doc_title STRING, champ STRING, runner STRING, score STRING, score_num DOUBLE, quadrennial STRING, multi STRING, qual_type STRING, type_text STRING) WITH PRIMARY_ID_AS_ATTRIBUTE="true"

ADD VERTEX Company (PRIMARY_ID id STRING, name STRING, doc_id STRING, doc_title STRING, industry STRING, type_text STRING, traded_as STRING, founded STRING, founded_num DOUBLE, website STRING, key_people STRING, revenue STRING, revenue_num DOUBLE, num_employees STRING, num_employees_num DOUBLE, net_income STRING, net_income_num DOUBLE, operating_income STRING, operating_income_num DOUBLE, products STRING, hq_location_city STRING, hq_location_country STRING, area_served STRING, assets STRING, assets_num DOUBLE, equity STRING, equity_num DOUBLE, hq_location STRING, founder STRING, founders STRING) WITH PRIMARY_ID_AS_ATTRIBUTE="true"

ADD VERTEX Writer (PRIMARY_ID id STRING, name STRING, doc_id STRING, doc_title STRING, birth_place STRING, occupation STRING, notable_works STRING, birth_date STRING, birth_date_year INT, birth_date_iso STRING, awards STRING, birth_name STRING, spouse STRING, death_date STRING, death_date_num DOUBLE, death_place STRING, children STRING, children_num DOUBLE, period STRING, genre STRING, language STRING, education STRING) WITH PRIMARY_ID_AS_ATTRIBUTE="true"

ADD VERTEX InternationalFootballCompetition (PRIMARY_ID id STRING, name STRING, doc_id STRING, doc_title STRING, country STRING, tourney_name STRING, year STRING, year_num DOUBLE, size STRING, size_num DOUBLE, dates STRING, dates_year INT, dates_iso STRING, confederations STRING, confederations_num DOUBLE, num_teams STRING, num_teams_num DOUBLE, venues STRING, venues_num DOUBLE, cities STRING, cities_num DOUBLE, count_text STRING, count_num DOUBLE, champion_other STRING, second_other STRING, third_other STRING, fourth_other STRING, matches STRING, matches_num DOUBLE, goals STRING, goals_num DOUBLE, top_scorer STRING, nextseason STRING, nextseason_num DOUBLE, fair_play STRING, prevseason STRING, prevseason_num DOUBLE) WITH PRIMARY_ID_AS_ATTRIBUTE="true"

ADD VERTEX Scientist (PRIMARY_ID id STRING, name STRING, doc_id STRING, doc_title STRING, birth_date STRING, birth_date_year INT, birth_date_iso STRING, birth_place STRING, workplaces STRING, education STRING, known_for STRING, doctoral_advisor STRING, awards STRING, death_date STRING, death_date_num DOUBLE, death_place STRING, field STRING, doctoral_students STRING, thesis_title STRING, thesis_url STRING, thesis_year STRING, thesis_year_num DOUBLE, birth_name STRING, fields STRING) WITH PRIMARY_ID_AS_ATTRIBUTE="true"
